classification.summary: MasterChef.depositByAddLiquidity() passes the caller-supplied token addresses straight into _doTransferIn and paraRouter.addLiquidity without checking them against the pool LP pair, and addLiquidityInternal then credits the deposit with the raw increase of the pool LP token balance (newBalance - oldBalance). The attacker supplied two tokens of their own whose transferFrom re-entered deposit(pid, amount) with real LP tokens, so the same real LP deposit was counted twice: once by the reentrant deposit and once as the balance delta measured by depositByAddLiquidity. Two withdraw() calls then removed roughly twice the LP that had been paid in.

loss.notes: Components are the MasterChef 0x633fa755a83b015cccdc451f82c57ea0bd32b4b4 net ERC-20 outflow across the 45 depositByAddLiquidity transactions of the campaign (blocks 16005645-16009258), with the seven Para-LP positions resolved into their underlying tokens at the pre-campaign pair state of block 16005644. Raw LP outflow: 220760.392147321091610368 USDT/BUSD LP (98.81% of supply), 14627.197755208809754584 CAKE/BUSD LP, 1674.617368475105344132 WBNB/BUSD LP, 441.367896732979141899 BTCB/BUSD LP, 422.118760287837538705 ETH/BUSD LP, 44.402791154001324517 ETH/WBNB LP and 34.988011674692057714 BTCB/WBNB LP, plus the single-asset pools' 12.937257935935226619 BTCB, 25.823882791173237295 WBNB and 40.931924021235680678 ETH. The 3,774,958.8 T42 minted into the MasterChef as block reward and the 45 worthless attacker-pair LP tokens deposited are excluded. Cross-check: the attacker EOA 0x94bc1d555e63eea23fe7fdbf937ef3f9ac5fcf8f went from 0.889503956097239466 BNB at block 16002700 to 4638.544756398378995119 BNB at block 16009400 after selling everything, i.e. about USD 1.74M realised against USD 1.78M of gross assets removed, the difference being swap fees and slippage. Nothing was recovered.

lastCodeChange.description: The second and last NewImplementation(address,address) the ParaProxy emitted before the exploit, log 373 of block 13657442, whose second data word installs 0xa386f30853a7eb7e6a25ec8389337a5c6973421d in place of 0x905072738158b5e74251c82e6165b62f3eb513a5. ParaProxyAdminStorage slot 2 reads 0x905072738158b5e74251c82e6165b62f3eb513a5 at block 13657441 and 0xa386f30853a7eb7e6a25ec8389337a5c6973421d from block 13657442 through block 16005644, and the anchor trace shows the proxy delegate-calling exactly that implementation for depositByAddLiquidity.

sources.note: Re-anchored. The v1 snapshot anchored to 0x70f367b9420ac2654a5223cc311c7f9c361736a39fd4e7dff9ed1b85bab7ad54 at block 16008281, which is the ninth defect-executing transaction of the campaign. Enumerating every log the MasterChef 0x633fa755a83b015cccdc451f82c57ea0bd32b4b4 emitted between blocks 16002000 and 16010000 isolates exactly 45 transactions carrying the Deposit,Deposit,Withdraw,Withdraw signature of the exploit; all 45 are successful and sent by 0x94bc1d555e63eea23fe7fdbf937ef3f9ac5fcf8f, and the earliest is 0xad03894a195e0fda0852491e8f3ad95b0177f943fceb9f25f198131d2c29fae7 at block 16005645 index 96, which is the new anchor. It is the first successful depositByAddLiquidity (selector 0xff09731b) of the campaign: the five earlier attempts through exploit contracts 0x8cb25c27, 0xac8f6d45, 0x781febd9, 0xf1ef6296, 0xf19c3e3e and 0x4d17c4ae all reverted, and the attacker transactions before them are ordinary deposit/withdraw calls that do not execute the defect. The anchor is a small rehearsal of the full attack against the single-asset BTCB pool and nets about 0.0000995 BTCB. The victim is a ParaProxy: ParaProxyAdminStorage puts admin at slot 0, pendingAdmin at 1, implementation at 2 and pendingImplementation at 3, and the fallback delegatecalls slot 2, so EIP-1967 does not apply. Its 1,339-byte runtime is unchanged (keccak(eth_getCode) 0x51a7d38fa15852fa2f9451040d0aac41bfa3135e188c04594dab2cc6505445ec at both block 13431009 and block 16005644). Enumerating all 5,316 logs the proxy emitted from its creation block 13431009 to block 16005644 gives exactly two NewImplementation(address,address) events (topic 0xd604de94d45953f9138079ec1b82d533cb2160c906d1076d1f7ed54befbca97a): block 13431092 index 109 log 292 installing 0x905072738158b5e74251c82e6165b62f3eb513a5, and block 13657442 index 133 log 373 installing 0xa386f30853a7eb7e6a25ec8389337a5c6973421d; the four NewPendingImplementation events (0xe945ccee) are the matching two-step proposals and there is no other code-selecting event. Storage slot 2 confirms the same transition (0x905072... at 13657441, 0xa386f308... at 13657442 and still at 16005644). The prestateTracer over the anchor transaction gives the implementation code hash 0x96e938633e5bd6f202fc89578d387aedbbc35160c9feda67c01b966673792946, and the anchor trace shows 0x633fa755 delegate-calling 0xa386f308 for 0xff09731b, so the exploited code is 7,066,558 s (81d 18h 55m 58s) old. Creator 0xd5c0bd4a6f30824e13b15282d431063bd01bd7d0 is the Paraluni deployer of both the proxy and both implementations, not the attacker. Loss is the MasterChef net ERC-20 outflow over the 45 exploit transactions, with Para-LP positions decomposed through pair reserves and totalSupply at block 16005644; it comes to USD 1,780,448.59, consistent with the attacker EOA ending the campaign with 4,638.5 BNB (about USD 1.74M) from 0.89 BNB.
